title: Rabbi Yishmael bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 122a, Resh Lakish was sitting and considering a question. Rabbi Yishmael bar Abba told him, “Thus said Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi.” Resh Lakish replied, “Sit opposite me” (well done). Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Shimon bar Abba.

notes.text: The consulted Chullin paragraph makes Yishmael speak to Resh Lakish, who then asks him to sit opposite him. The parenthetical “well done” is Hyman’s gloss, not an additional spoken clause.
The consulted Chullin passage has Yishmael. The Shimon reading in Dikdukei Soferim is reported by Hyman.
